requested_filters: Independently operating public/outside-customer-facing brand with no controlling corporate parent
Verified no first-party website after exact-IČO alias search, OR independently observed substantial website flaws
filter_review.conclusion: No companies passed BOTH filters. Five individual-shareholder founding records are not equivalent to verified independent customer-facing business; both corporate-controlled entities excluded. No existing attributable site was available for a technical redesign audit.
filter_review.no_site_claims: None. Searches are not enough to certify absence; no browser-observed critical functional, mobile, or HTTPS defects verified.
website_queries_checked: Exact business names and eight-digit IČOs with contact/website/web keywords
Likely no-space or hyphenated name .cz/.pro spellings
Directory and social-platform name matches; no exact-IČO site substantiated
cautions: Do not confuse FDF Autoservis with similarly named Autoservis DDF, a different operator/location.
Do not conflate Abrova Group with Abrovia or Abbreva, both different entities.
Do not confuse KA-mont system with other KA-mont/Kavamont/Kapamont operations.
Do not infer absence of website from a fruitless search or inaccessibility.
